props.name: selected
props.description: Whether the chip is selected. Only used with onSelectedChange.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Makes the chip a toggle. Called with the new selected state.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Adds a remove button. Called when it is pressed.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon or emoji shown before the text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stop the chip from being used.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
